component.name: Blink
component.summary: Privacy-first biometric Face ID and face unlock for Linux

description.p: Blink brings ultra-fast, 100% offline biometric facial recognition unlock to Linux desktops. Powered by lightweight YuNet face detection and 512-dimensional ArcFace deep Euclidean embeddings, Blink verifies your identity locally on CPU in under 15ms with zero telemetry and zero cloud calls.

ul.li: 100% Offline: All neural weights run strictly on your local device.
Instant Screen Unlock: Sub-25ms virtual hardware injection via /dev/uinput.
Apple-grade Lockscreen UI: Sleek squircle floating biometric card matching desktop lockscreens.
Low Resource Footprint: Uses less than 150 MB RAM and runs smoothly on standard modern CPUs.
Universal Camera Support: Compatible with standard USB webcams, integrated laptop cameras, and infrared (IR) sensors.

description.p: Blink release with optimized YuNet 5-point landmark detection and lockscreen biometric overlay.
